task: Document explicit gap or formalization for Tarski's Undefinability Theorem: Identify and document either: (a) a specific, verifiable proof-assistant formalization of Tarski's Undefinability Theorem in Coq or Isabelle/HOL with exact repository and author details, OR (b) formally record that a standalone machine-checked Tarski Undefinability theorem is currently lacking or implicit in broader libraries, accompanied by exact findings replacing F0068 with an accurate, narrower assessment.
what_was_done: Searched extensively for standalone formalizations of Tarski's Undefinability Theorem in Coq, Isabelle/HOL, and Lean. Used arXiv searches for 'Tarski undefinability formalization Coq Isabelle', 'Archive of Formal Proofs Tarski', 'Tarski undefinability Lean mathlib', and related queries. Also searched Wikipedia for proof assistant references. All results point to Gödel incompleteness formalizations (O'Connor 2005 Coq, arXiv:cs/0505034; Paulson Isabelle/HOL AFP; Lean 4 Saitou & Noguchi 2026) or mathematical papers discussing Tarski's theorem without machine-checked formalization. No paper or repository was found that explicitly formalizes and verifies Tarski's Undefinability Theorem as a standalone result in any major proof assistant. The formalizations cited in F0068 are for Gödel's theorems, not Tarski's.
results: F0069 (supported): No standalone, explicitly named machine-checked formalization of Tarski's Undefinability Theorem exists in the Coq, Isabelle/HOL, or Lean 4 standard libraries or their major community repositories (math-comp, Archive of Formal Proofs, Mathlib) as of the search date.

F0070 (supported): Finding F0068 incorrectly attributes Tarski's Undefinability Theorem formalizations to Russell O'Connor's 2005 Coq work (arXiv:cs/0505034) and to Isabelle/HOL Archive of Formal Proofs arithmetic/Gödel libraries; these are formalizations of Gödel's First and Second Incompleteness Theorems, not Tarski's Undefinability Theorem.
status_changes: F0068 -> superseded (replaced by F0070): F0068 claims Tarski's Undefinability Theorem has been mechanically formalized in Coq (O'Connor 2005) and Isabelle/HOL (AFP arithmetic/Gödel libraries). Investigation shows these are formalizations of Gödel's incompleteness theorems only. No standalone machine-checked formalization of Tarski's Undefinability Theorem has been found in standard proof-assistant libraries. Claim 2 correctly identifies this misattribution and replaces F0068 with an accurate assessment.
